observations: A large outdoor pile of used car tyres.
A blue plastic chair is visible in the center of the frame.

The setting appears to be a tyre shop or a scrap yard.

claims.evidence: No brand markings are visible on the tyres in photo 0.
The photo is too distant to read the wear indicators or measure the tread depth.

The age and previous vehicle history cannot be determined from a photo of the exterior.

risks.risk: The tyre may be expired (old rubber).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the 4-digit DOT code on the sidewall.

risks.risk: The tread depth may be significantly below 1.6mm.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the tread with a coin or ruler for scale.

risks.risk: The tyre may have hidden structural damage or cracks.
risks.proof: A video showing the inside of the tyre.

proof_requests: Close-up of any brand or model name on the tyre.
Photo of the 4-digit DOT code on the sidewall.
Photo of the tread depth using a coin or ruler.
Photo of the inside of the tyre to check for cracks or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
